# PDFXpert - 100% Offline PDF & Document Tools Suite

> PDFXpert is an open, client-side web application providing 40+ document utilities including PDF merging, compression, AI semantic chat, OCR, splitting, signing, scanning, and universal format conversions running completely in-browser without server transmission.

## Core Features & Tool Endpoints

- [Merge PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/merge): Combine multiple PDF documents into a single file with custom page rotation and re-ordering.
- [Compress PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/compress): Optimize and compress PDF documents in memory with selectable compression quality presets.
- [Split PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/split): Extract specific pages or split documents into multiple PDF ranges.
- [AI PDF Chat](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/chat-pdf): In-browser semantic search, question-answering, and content synthesis over PDF documents.
- [AI PDF Summarizer](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/summarize-pdf): Extract key bullet points, concise executive summaries, or comprehensive overviews.
- [PDF Scanner](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/scan): Capture document photos via webcam or camera with document enhancement filters and compile to PDF.
- [PDF OCR](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/ocr): Extract searchable text from scanned documents using in-browser neural OCR.
- [PDF Converter](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/pdf-converter): Convert PDFs to Word, Excel, PowerPoint, JPG, PNG, HTML, or plain text.
- [Protect PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/protect): Encrypt PDF files with client-side standard AES password protection.
- [Unlock PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/unlock): Remove password protection from authenticated PDF files.
- [Watermark PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/watermark): Apply customizable text or image watermarks with opacity and rotation controls.
- [Passport Photo Sheet Maker](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/passport-photo-maker): Tile passport and visa photos onto A4 / 4x6 sheets with cutting guides and 1-click studio printing.
- [Batch PDF Automation](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/bulk-pdf): Process 10 to 50+ PDF files simultaneously (bulk compress, watermark, rotate) and export as ZIP package.
- [Fillable PDF Form Builder](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/form-builder): Create official fillable AcroForm PDFs by placing text boxes, checkboxes, dropdowns, dates, and signature areas.
- [Sign & Edit PDF](https://pdfxpert.pages.dev/tools/edit-pdf): Draw signatures, place text annotations, shapes, and redact sensitive information.

## Security & Architecture

- **Execution Model**: 100% Client-Side WebAssembly (WASM) and isolated WebWorkers.
- **Data Privacy**: Zero cloud uploads. Documents are processed in RAM memory and never leave the user device.
- **Licensing**: Free Community Edition and Offline Cryptographic Pro Licensing.
